servers.name: Xynaptic MCP Server
servers.description: 200+ pay-per-call data & AI APIs for agents — official French registries (INPI RNE, DVF), US SEC EDGAR, live energy (RTE, ENTSO-E), health (openFDA, PubMed), travel & flights (SNCF, FAA NOTAMs), plus 6 LLM-powered Dev Kit tools (code review, fix, refactor, test generation, error explanation, security audit) and 3 x402-paid agent skills. Payments in USDC via x402 on Base, Solana or Polygon — no API key, no subscription.

auth.description: Each paid tool call returns an x402 challenge (402) — pay in USDC and retry with PAYMENT-SIGNATURE, or set XYNAPTIC_SUB_KEY for subscription access
